'''Tumors''' were a type of unnatural growth often found on the brain of an individual. One was discovered on the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Tup/Legends|CT-5385]], "Tup," which was considered rare by the [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] who discovered it, [[AZI-345211896246498721347/Legends|AZI-3]].
